svg.aria-label: The AI-augmented design-to-build stack in six layers, read bottom to top. Layer zero, foundation, inherited and authored separately: Cloudscape plus fifteen design tenets, nineteen standard tenets, and seventeen component specs. Layer one, audit schema version 2.5.1: 103 machine-checkable rules across 13 page types with 15 exceptions. Layer two, context: nineteen context files carry the standards, schema, and page-type taxonomy to the agents. Layer three, capabilities: sixteen skills, one agent, and three SOPs, totalling 39 validated capabilities built on Kiro. Layer four, run modes: interactive and persona-aware for local development, deterministic in CI. Layer five, enforcement: violations affect code reviews while persona feedback ships as non-blocking advisory cards. Every finding traces down to a design tenet, and each layer is generated from the one below.
